quote: We conducted extensive experiments on language tasks to support our claims and believe that these insights can significantly improve the Transformer's performance in length extrapolation.

In this paper, we point out that the key of Transformer length extrapolation is the better and more accurate attention score. Therefore, we develop and analyze CDAPE by processing the attention score as feature maps via convolution operation.
outputs: The paper focuses on language modeling where the generated outputs are next-token predictions in autoregressive language modeling tasks.

quote: the perplexity (ppl) of attention decreases significantly-from over 600 to just above 100-when trained on a sequence length of 128 and evaluated on a length of 8192.
... achieve a perplexity score of 4.60 on the arXiv dataset and 23.52 on the Books3 dataset ...
In addition to perplexity, we also leverage downstream datasets with randomized positional encoding to further assess CDAPE.
